feeds.title: Frontline Magazine
feeds.description: Frontline is India's national magazine from the publishers of The Hindu. Get in-depth analysis of issues and events in India and around the world in the fields of politics, economy, industry, social justice, the environment, culture, literature, cinema, art, science and media.

feeds.title: Frontline Magazine » India
feeds.description: Latest India story features, analysis and essays on India. Eminent writers comment on issues such as Indian politics, Indian economy, Indian society and the development of art and culture in India.

feeds.title: Frontline Magazine » Politics
feeds.description: Frontline Coverage about latest India political news. Covers the BJP, the Congress, CPI(M) and other left parties, DMK, BJD, Shiv Sena and political developments and trends in the country. Unbiased, brave reporting.

feeds.title: Frontline Magazine » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: Frontline Arts & Cultures News - Best source of news in entertainment, art, culture, cinema, travel, heritage, exhibitions, music, architecture, history and books.

feeds.title: Frontline Magazine » Current Issue
feeds.description: Frontline Latest Issue - Get detailed analysis of current affairs and issues in politics, economy, social affairs, art, culture, cinema, international relations, science and technology, business, finance and economy in current issue.

feeds.title: Frontline Magazine » World Affairs
feeds.description: World News from Frontline. Brilliant, detailed and unbiased reporting on international affairs from the global south point of view.

feeds.description: Frontline Columnist opinion & insights, views and analysis from the best writers, thinkers, artists and experts in India, from across the world.
